categories.main_business_segments: Jiangyin Pivot Automotive Products Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of automotive nylon pipes and connectors. Its main products include power system connection pipes, cooling system connection pipes, and connectors, mainly serving the passenger car market. The company is a key supplier to well-known domestic and international automotive brands, including Volkswagen, Audi, BYD, Volvo, Mercedes-Benz, and BMW.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as CREO, CATIA, UG, CAD for product design and simulation, and 3D printing for rapid prototyping. It has a mold processing center for in-house mold design and manufacturing. Production methods include injection molding, extrusion, forming, and welding, with precise control over process parameters like temperature and pressure to ensure product quality and stability. The company also applies PLM systems for collaborative development and data management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive OEMs and tier-1 suppliers such as FAW-Volkswagen, SAIC Volkswagen, BYD, Li Auto, Chery, Leapmotor, Hutchinson, Contitech, Aptiv, and Schaeffler. The company serves primarily the passenger vehicle segment, including traditional fuel vehicles and new energy vehicles (EV, PHEV, FCV). Its products are integrated into mainstream and popular models across these brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 90% of revenue. It also has some export sales, though these have declined recently. In 2024, it established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Wuhu, Anhui Province to expand production capacity and presence in the new energy vehicle sector. The company’s financial reports indicate limited overseas operations but maintain some exposure to international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangyin Pivot Automotive Products Co., Ltd. operates primarily as a midstream supplier in the automotive supply chain, manufacturing critical nylon pipe and connector components. It acts as a tier-1 supplier directly to OEMs and also as a tier-2 supplier through other tier-1 suppliers. The company is involved in product development and synchronized R&D with OEMs, indicating a close upstream collaboration but focused on component manufacturing rather than vehicle assembly or raw material production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding its product portfolio in the new energy vehicle sector, emphasizing lightweight, high-performance composite materials, and advanced thermal management systems. R&D efforts target innovations such as multi-angle quick connectors, integrated thermal management modules, high-sealing quick connectors, and high thermal conductivity plastic liquid cooling plates for battery packs. It aims to enhance product quality, reduce costs, and accelerate product development cycles through digital tools and collaboration with research institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive nylon pipes, connectors, and related components to OEMs and tier-1 suppliers. The company follows a direct sales model with contracts typically involving technical evaluation, development, and long-term supply agreements. It also earns income from government subsidies and financial product investments, but the core revenue is product sales based on customer orders and production schedules.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of automotive nylon pipes and connectors, competing with international suppliers such as Bondi TI, Teklas, Kayser, Pass, and Fraenkisch. It is recognized for meeting stringent quality standards comparable to European and American brands and has a strong foothold in supplying joint venture OEMs in China. Its competitive advantages include early entry into OEM supply chains, technical innovation, and product quality, enabling it to pursue domestic substitution of imported products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 513.7 million, a 10% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 121.6 million, down 18.3%. Despite a slight decline in revenue and profit, the company maintains a solid asset base of RMB 1.65 billion and equity of RMB 1.44 billion. It has shown steady investment in R&D with expenditures exceeding RMB 27.7 million, representing over 5% of revenue, indicating a commitment to growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, advanced manufacturing processes, and close collaboration with OEMs for synchronized development. Its nylon pipes and connectors offer superior performance in weight reduction, oil resistance, and heat resistance, supporting automotive lightweighting and environmental goals. It differentiates itself through rapid response capabilities, in-house mold design, and a broad product range tailored for both traditional and new energy vehicles, positioning itself as a reliable partner for high-end automotive brands.
